scope: Follow-up of existing coverage C1-2 and C7-1; no new dissertation, raw data refit, original baseline overwrite or expensive simulation.

extraction_bound.status: Conservative figure-geometry criterion inherited from the existing quarter-point source-extraction convention; not original measurement precision or sampling uncertainty.
extraction_bound.limits: Good geometric fit does not prove the original simulation or estimation procedure. No numerical rounding verdict for parameters unprinted by source.

figure1_3.finding: Rendered curves are consistent with equal discrimination 2 and difficulties−2,−.5 under their labelled axes. Eq. 1.1 is unit-slope, but the caption only says equal discrimination; rescaling or illustrative estimation may explain this. No author-error conclusion.
figure1_3.idealized_curve_limit: A unit-discrimination illustration at difficulties ±.5 preserves qualitative ordering but does not reconstruct these plotted source curves.
figure1_3.resolved: Source-figure curve coordinates and simple logistic parameterization are recoverable; random seed is unnecessary for this geometric check.
figure1_3.unresolved: Original simulated test data, item estimates, seed and plot driver remain unavailable; inferred curve parameters are not verified true generating parameters.

figure7_1.finding: Exactly 10,000 markers per panel recovered. First panel is nearly, but not exactly, noiseless: extracted sample residual variance≈.001 and correlation≈.99950. Second panel gives genetic/residual sample variances≈.505/.502 and correlation≈.70955.
figure7_1.candidate_scope: Plot-derived sample variances are not robustly known population parameters; the fixed-axis quarter-point coordinate envelope for first panel residual variance includes zero even though exact affine collinearity fails the joint coordinate-box feasibility check. Variances 1/.001 and .5/.5 are plausible generating values, not recovered original driver parameters. They are consistent with source approximate≈ statements and sample variation. No significance/equivalence conclusion.
figure7_1.idealized_scenario_limit: An exact E=0 reconstruction is an idealized limit, not the actual first panel point cloud.
figure7_1.remaining: Original seed/driver not recovered; repetition of the original simulation is unestablished. Source point statistics are deterministic geometric extraction, not independent replication.

independence: Curve reconstruction uses nonlinear probability-space optimization and independent central-logit linearization on shared source coordinates. Marker counts and moment identities use same plot, not new empirical data.
